items.item: The page header has a plural title ("Stock movements") and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 "Lịch sử xuất nhập kho" (movement history, Vietnamese; not literally a plural noun). Header has one filled indigo button "Tạo phiếu" and #btnExport "Xuất CSV" as an outlined secondary button. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The movements table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (movement type, warehouse, date range) and no decorative hero above it
items.evidence: Table starts at y=312 and rows are visible in the first viewport; no hero. But there is a search plus 5 visible filter controls (#type, #wh, #status, #from, #to), i.e. an extra Status filter beyond the 2-3 limit, and a 4-tile KPI row (#kpis) sits above the table.

items.item: Movement type is shown as a text label combined with an icon or shape, not by colour alone, and the set of types is limited to receipt, issue, transfer and adjustment
items.evidence: Exactly four types (in/out/transfer/adjust), shown as coloured text pills. TYPES defines symbols (+, −, ⇄, ±) in field `s`, but render() never outputs them, so there is no icon, only text on a colour-tinted pill that wraps to two lines ("Xuất / kho").

items.item: Quantity changes carry an explicit + or − sign, are right-aligned with tabular figures, and the unit of measure is in the column header or a separate unit column, not repeated inside cells
items.evidence: Cells are right-aligned with .num (tabular-nums). The sign is only added for in (+) and out (−); transfer and adjust rows show an unsigned total (screenshot: adjust row "19", transfer "145"; sign = '' in render()). The header "Số lượng" has no unit and there is no unit column (units are mixed per line).

items.item: A transfer row shows both the source and destination warehouse, and each row has a human-readable document number plus an absolute date and time
items.evidence: whCell renders `${r.wh} → ${r.to}` for transfers ("Kho Hải Phòng → Kho Tổng Bình Dương"); codes like PX-2611-1200 / PC-2611-1193; dt() gives "17:00 04/11/2026".

items.item: A running balance or resulting on-hand quantity column is available so users can reconcile each movement
items.evidence: Columns are Thời gian, Mã phiếu, Loại, Kho, Đối tác/Lý do, Số dòng, Số lượng, Giá trị, Trạng thái, Người tạo. There is no balance or on-hand column.

items.item: The table is sorted by date, newest first, by default, with `aria-sort` on the sorted header and pagination at the bottom with a page-size control
items.evidence: Default st={sort:'date',dir:-1} gives newest first, and pagination with #size (10/20/50), Trước/Sau is at the bottom. But no th has aria-sort; the sort state is only a ▼ glyph in span.sort-ind, and the sortable th elements are not buttons.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading skeleton and an error state with retry are also present
items.evidence: #empty shows only "Không có phiếu nào khớp bộ lọc hiện tại." with no clear-filters button inside (the "Xóa bộ lọc" button is in the filter bar). There is no first-use empty state, no loading skeleton (audit loadingPlaceholders=0) and no error or retry state.

items.item: Icon-only controls have accessible names, interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: There are no real icon-only controls (the drawer close button has an aria-label), and audit smallTargets=0. But the audit text-contrast check fails 6 times: KPI sub-text text-slate-400 at 2.56:1, and the "Đang xử lý" status badge at 4.34:1.

notes: Vietnamese UI. Tells: thead uses `uppercase tracking-wide` (audit uppercase-text warn x9). Type and status pills use emerald, rose, sky, amber and blue families (rainbow-status). The sidebar is bg-slate-900 and the primary button is indigo-600. A 4-tile KPI row sits above the table, but without icons, so kpi-icon-tiles is not flagged. Other audit findings: 65px two-line rows (9 over the limit), because pills and status badges wrap. The Số lượng column sums absolute line quantities across mixed units, which is not reconcilable. The "Chuyển đến …" partner text duplicates the destination warehouse. Score is 72/100.
